newsitem.title: USA: $17.9 bln flows into stock funds in Aug - ICI.
newsitem.headline: $17.9 bln flows into stock funds in Aug - ICI.

text.p: About $17.93 billion in net new cash flowed into stock mutual funds in August versus $5.76 billion, according to final data compiled by the Investment Company Institute.
Net new cash into all funds totalled $30.50 billion in August, compared to $27.10 billion in July, according to the ICI, a major fund industry trade group.
Combined assets of all funds increased to $3.224 trillion from a revised $3.139 trillion in July.
Net new cash into bond and income funds totalled $1.7 million in August versus an outflow of $1 billion in July.
Money market funds had inflows of $12.58 billion in August versus $22.35 billion in July.
